text:
Elena Ruiz: Calypso Health flagged their private renewal (invoice 130301) — they say platform fee looks prorated incorrectly and an HSM vendor pass-through appears to be double-billed. Can we triage?
Raj Patel: Can you paste the invoice lines? I'll pull ledger and vendor invoice.
Elena Ruiz: Snippet from 130301:
```
Invoice 130301 (renewal)
- Private deployment license (annual): $120,000
- Platform fee (annual): $18,000
- Platform fee proration credit: -$6,000
- HSM vendor pass-through: $6,400
- HSM vendor pass-through (duplicate): $6,400
- Support (Committed 24/7): $30,000
- True-up (overage Q4): $4,500
Total: $179,300
```
Marta Liu: Interesting. The platform fee proration credit looks like it assumes support downgrade mid-term, but our contract shows they upgraded support mid-term (Std->Committed). That should have reduced proration, not increased it. Also vendor pass-through duplication might be because VendorInvoice V-9876 was attached and also mapped to account-level adjustment.
BillingBot: (automated) Received dispute for invoice 130301. Scanning invoice history and vendor memos. Found: duplicate HSM pass-through memo (V-9876 applied twice during migration), and platform proration flagged as inconsistent with support change logs. Opening case BLG-2026-1102.
Raj Patel: OK—two separate fixes: (A) remove duplicate vendor pass-through and create credit note; (B) recalc platform proration based on actual support change timestamp. Omar, can you confirm metering/support-change timestamps?
Billing Eng - Omar: Confirmed. Support change effective 2025-10-05; renewal date 2026-01-01. Platform fee proration should be pro-rated only if a platform tier changed (it didn't). The -$6,000 looks wrong.
Marta Liu: Also check vendor invoice V-9876: vendor billed us $6,400 once. We should not pass it twice. I suspect migration script created an account adjustment for the vendor charge and then ingested the vendor invoice again.
Legal - Tessa: Contract note: vendor pass-throughs are billed at cost; we can only refund pass-through if we were billed back by vendor or if the company error duplicated charge. Keep messaging factual and non-admissive.
Raj Patel: Proposed remediation plan: (1) Remove duplicate pass-through line and create CN-7102 for $6,400; (2) Recalculate platform proration and debit back $3,200 if needed (if original -6,000 becomes -2,800, we owe them $3,200). Net effect may be credit or small debit. Approve?
Marta Liu: Approve conditional on reconciliation. We need a ledger reconciliation file and PDF of corrected invoice before outreach.
BillingBot: (automated) Credit note CN-7102 queued for $6,400. Case BLG-2026-1102 updated.
Elena Ruiz: I'll draft the customer note: "We've identified an internal billing duplication affecting the HSM pass-through and an incorrect proration calculation. We're issuing a corrective credit note and will send a corrected invoice. Please let us know if you prefer a cash refund instead of applying credit to your next invoice." Want Legal to review.
Legal - Tessa: Fine. Suggest adding: "This correction reflects an internal billing error; no action needed from you unless you prefer a cash refund." Keep it short.
Raj Patel: Reconciliation calc (working): original invoice total 179,300
- remove dup pass-through: -6,400 -> 172,900
- adjust proration from -6,000 to -2,800 (debit customer 3,200) -> 176,100 net
So net refund to customer = 3,200 (they were over-credited), wait that's inconsistent. Let me re-run and post snapshot.
Billing Eng - Omar: I exported billing events; I'll attach CSV to case. Quick note: vendor pass-through duplication appears only in invoicing layer, not in ledger payments.
Marta Liu: Once Omar attaches CSV and Raj posts final numbers, Finance will approve CN application vs refund. If refund requested, route to payments with case BLG-2026-1102 and tag "refund-approval".
Elena Ruiz: Customer prefers credit to next invoice per initial reply. I'll hold customer message until final PDFs are ready and Legal signs off.
BillingBot: (automated) CN-7102 created (pending application). Awaiting reconciliation attachment.
Raj Patel: Uploaded reconciliation snapshot and corrected totals PDF to case. Final corrected invoice total should be $176,100 and CN-7102 net application = $6,400 credit then invoice adjustment debit of $3,200 -> net credit $3,200 applied to next invoice.
Marta Liu: Approved. Finance will apply CN-7102 to the account and schedule net credit of $3,200 to next invoice. If customer later requests refund, escalate to payments. Elena, please send the approved customer note and attach corrected invoice + CN.
Elena Ruiz: Customer message sent with attachments. Closing plan: apply CN, reissue invoice, close BLG-2026-1102 after ledger entries posted.
BillingBot: (automated) Case BLG-2026-1102 resolved after CN application and invoice reissue. Notifying stakeholders.
Elena Ruiz: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
